title: MTRCB reviews over 100 complaints vs ‘PBB Collab 3.0’

blocks.text: The Movie and Television Review and Classification Board (MTRCB) said it is reviewing more than 100 complaints it has received from viewers regarding scenes and interactions in recent episodes of “Pinoy Big Brother: Collab Edition 3.0.” In a statement on Thursday, Nov. 12, the MTRCB said it would discuss the concerns raised by viewers with the show’s production team as part of its review. “While this is underway, the MTRCB reminded PBB management to exercise greater care to ensure that each episode complies with the guidelines for the reality television show’s assigned age rating,” it said.
